technique.summary: Manipulate prices, quantities, or discount values in client-to-server requests to purchase items at reduced cost, get negative-value refunds, or bypass payment validation.
steps: Map the checkout flow and identify all requests that include price/quantity/discount data
Intercept the request at the point where the order is submitted
Test negative quantities: does ordering -1 item credit your account?
Test zero price: can you set price=0 or total=0?
Test currency manipulation: change USD to a weaker currency
Verify by checking the actual charge or account balance

payloads.notes: Negative quantity — may result in credit to account

bypassTechniques: Try modifying prices at different stages of the checkout flow
Use race conditions to apply a coupon multiple times
Mix currencies if multi-currency is supported
Test with different number formats: 1e-10, 0.001, scientific notation
